legend: Peter got a new snow blower as a New Year present. Of course, Peter decided to try it immediately. After reading the instructions he realized that it does not work like regular snow blowing machines. In order to make it work, you need to tie it to some point that it does not cover, and then switch it on. As a result it will go along a circle around this point and will remove all the snow from its path.

Formally, we assume that Peter's machine is a polygon on a plane. Then, after the machine is switched on, it will make a circle around the point to which Peter tied it (this point lies strictly outside the polygon). That is, each of the points lying within or on the border of the polygon will move along the circular trajectory, with the center of the circle at the point to which Peter tied his machine.
Peter decided to tie his car to point P and now he is wondering what is the area of ​​the region that will be cleared from snow. Help him.
input: The first line of the input contains three integers — the number of vertices of the polygon n (![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5b059d10e00a903bb105cfb827a89ceb19833f07.png)), and coordinates of point P.

Each of the next n lines contains two integers — coordinates of the vertices of the polygon in the clockwise or counterclockwise order. It is guaranteed that no three consecutive vertices lie on a common straight line.
All the numbers in the input are integers that do not exceed 1 000 000 in their absolute value.
output: Print a single real value number — the area of the region that will be cleared. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed 10 - 6.

legend.ai: Peter 收到了一台新的扫雪机作为新年礼物。当然，Peter 决定立即试用它。读完说明书后，他意识到这台机器的工作方式与普通扫雪机不同。为了让它工作，你需要将它系在某个不会被它覆盖的点上，然后启动机器。这样，它就会绕着这个点沿圆周运动，并清除路径上的所有积雪。
形式化地说，我们假设 Peter 的机器是平面上的一个多边形。启动机器后，它会绕着 Peter 将其系住的点画圆，该点严格位于多边形外部。也就是说，位于多边形内部或边界上的每个点，都会沿着以 Peter 系住机器的点为圆心的圆形轨迹移动。
Peter 决定将他的机器系在点 P 上，现在他想知道最终会被清除积雪的区域面积。请帮助他。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含三个整数，即多边形的顶点数 n(![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5b059d10e00a903bb105cfb827a89ceb19833f07.png))以及点 P 的坐标。
接下来的 n 行中，每行包含两个整数，即多边形顶点的坐标，这些顶点按照顺时针或逆时针顺序给出。保证不存在三个连续的顶点位于同一直线上。
输入中的所有数均为整数，且其绝对值不超过 1 000 000。

output.ai: 输出一个实数，即将被清除区域的面积。如果答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10 - 6，则会被判定为正确。
具体来说：假设你的答案为 a，评测器的答案为 b。当且仅当 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png) 时，校验程序会认为你的答案正确。
